name: Reversible ventilation unit with ceramic regenerator and R290 heat pump
test_stand: Institute of Heat Engineering, Warsaw University of Technology

air.note: 1400 m3/h nominal in the thesis; max measured supply 1380 m3/h in the paper

cycle.note: dwell = half of the 4 s guide-vane turn, at each reversal (paper, Eq. 1)

aux_power_w.note: fan + automation, constant over the whole range of outdoor temperatures

channels.T1..T5: air temperatures, °C (positions in Fig. 1 of the thesis)
channels.RH1..RH5: relative humidity at the same points, fraction 0-1
channels.note: roles as used in the thesis; exact sensor positions to be confirmed against the logging scripts

ceramic.note: bottom row 74 mm in the thesis, 72 mm in the paper; cp = 99 528 J/K / 113.1 kg (paper)
